title: Retire the finished memory capsule so state check runs quiet
body:
Outcome: krn state check --root . prints no warnings at session start; the memory lane's finished capsule stops adding noise to every resume.
Evidence: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/memory/state.md (parallel lane B, fixed point ab1b0e6 at #221) warns disposition-without-evidence and stale-fixed-point on every check (2026-11-08 at 5cc3f2e); every next action it names (t-vwsz7hs, t-8wes0jn, t-z2wbk07, t-v7jkfb7, t-33mv33n) is closed; its cleanup list keeps 7 .krn/runs/lead folders 'delete when the memory lane completes'. The installed krn state check turns a COMPLETE capsule with a stale HEAD anchor into an error, so a finished capsule has to leave rather than stay COMPLETE.
Acceptance: open memory work (t-y46gy0w) is named in the session-continuity capsule; the memory capsule and the cleanup folders it lists are deleted after grep shows no open task, tracked file or other capsule points into them; krn state check --root . exits 0 with an empty warnings list.
